svg.title: Finite capture in parameter and dynamical planes
svg.desc: Three independently computed binary64 production rasters: M3, the fixed-first-digit subset F5,0, and E(2i,5). Shade cycles by the minimum inverse depth at each pixel center. Geometric parameter-cell or dynamical-footprint coverage remains separate and pale when it survives without capture. E(2i,5) retains the color and black boundary of every first-level piece. Minimum depths are numerical search results, not full-cell or interval certificates.
svg.text: Finite capture in parameter and dynamical planes
Shade records minimum inverse depth at the pixel center. Whole-pixel coverage keeps the fine structure visible.

g.aria-label: M3 parameter cells with minimum capture of 2c in the five-map difference attractor.
g.text: Base capture and successive inverse levels

g.aria-label: The F5,0 parameter subset with first digit0 and original A5 tail; minimum capture begins at one.
g.text: First digit 0; every later digit belongs to A₅

g.aria-label: E(2i,5) with minimum center capture levels and black contours around every overlapping first-level piece.
g.text: Whole-set depth starts at 0; piece edges stay black

svg.text: Dark bands: minimum capture depth mod 3 · solid hue: capture with minimum unconfirmed · pale hue: finite escape coverage
Capture limit 12 · escape depth 12 · canonical strict-lens capture only · fixed first digits count as one step
Inside the original lens: M⁰ₙ captures at 0, M¹ₙ at 1. Individual first digits can require later capture.
